texts.title: Oakdale Public Library
texts.content:
Changes at the Front Desk
Starting January 6, the Oakdale Public Library will no longer print checkout receipts.
Instead, a list of your borrowed items and due dates will be emailed to you.
You can also see this information anytime in the Oakdale Library app.
This change will save over 40,000 sheets of paper each year.
If we do not have your email address, please give it to a staff member at the front desk or add it under My Account on our website.
Patrons without email may still ask for a printed list, and staff will be happy to help.
We will also stop mailing overdue reminders. You will receive these by email or by phone instead.
Thank you for helping us go green!

options: C. To sell more library cards
